propositions: A cancelled or timed-out mutation job in the Gerrit Verified Gate casts Verified -1 with a message exactly 'CANCELLED: <run URL>' that names no job and gives no reason, making triage opaque without opening the run and reading job conclusions by hand.

The gerrit-review-action used by the gate self-builds its message as 'STATUS: SERVER_URL/REPOSITORY/actions/runs/RUN_ID' with no input for custom text, so failure detail cannot be delivered through that action.

Two different failure causes produce the identical 'CANCELLED: <url>' vote: timeout-minutes: 30 being exceeded and a stale-base version-skew error on the selector step, making it impossible to distinguish which needs author action.

The summarize_ci_failures.py script aggregates job-level GitHub API data (list-jobs payload and per-job check-run annotations) to render each non-successful job as TIMED OUT vs CANCELLED vs FAILED with name and duration, returning empty string when all jobs succeed.

An SSH 'gerrit review <change>,<patchset> --message' step posts the triage detail as a comment-only review after the vote is cast, guarded on vote-type != 'success' and continue-on-error so the vote cannot be redacted by post-vote logic.

The implementation strips quotes, backslashes, and control characters from job names before interpolating them into the remote command, and validates change/patchset against ^[1-9][0-9]*$ to prevent shell injection.
